AC-2: confirm current state before changing anything -- read scripts/orchestrator.py's ENGINEER_PROMPT and confirm it does not currently instruct engineer sessions to run validation commands in the foreground/awaited regardless of the CLI's own auto-background timeout; confirm decide_start's resume path has no detection today for 'worktree has staged-but-uncommitted git changes AND relay never advanced past SESSION_START AND pid is dead'.

AC-5: no change to any other decide_start branch or outcome (dispatch / refuse / ordinary resume for an already-active relay all behave exactly as before); no change to the merge-lock hook or the privacy-gate hook.

AC-6: targeted tests for AC-4's new detection logic as a pure function (git status parsed/monkeypatched, no real subprocess spawn), following tests/test_orchestrator.py's existing style for decide_start coverage.

AC-7: validation and state: targeted tests green; because scripts/orchestrator.py is shared core, run the full one-shot regression once (DEV.TEST.1) rather than reusing stale evidence; project-state bookkeeping (backlog.json status update for this item, build_history record) lands in this PR.
